name: Cheviot Company Limited
summary: Cheviot Company Limited makes and sells jute-based goods, including shopping bags, yarns, Hessian cloth and bags, sacking and decorative fabrics. It sells mainly in India and exports worldwide. Incorporated in 1897 as Budge Budge Amalgamated Mills Limited, it has its main office in Kolkata and is a subsidiary of Harsh Investments Private Limited.
